name: Real Engineering
author: Kandown
description: A delivery workflow that turns a reviewed specification into tracer-bullet vertical slices, applies test-first work at valuable seams, and reviews standards separately from intent.
summary: Specify, slice vertically, test important seams, then run independent Standards and Spec reviews.

taskTemplates.name: Feature specification
taskTemplates.description: Defines the problem, user outcomes, acceptance criteria, decisions, and non-goals.

taskTemplates.name: Tracer-bullet slice
taskTemplates.description: Delivers one thin end-to-end behavior that proves the integration path.

taskTemplates.name: Standards review
taskTemplates.description: Reviews the diff only against repository and engineering standards.

taskTemplates.name: Spec review
taskTemplates.description: Reviews delivered behavior only against the approved specification.
